periods.description: Ancient mechanical dragon armor excavated from ruins and used as the dominant military, diplomatic, and industrial technology of the world.
periods.principles: A paired Sword Device summons a stored Drag-Ride by spatial transfer, then links armor parts to the pilot through Force Core energy and Philosopher's Stone/Steel materials.
periods.classification: General-purpose Drag-Rides, Divine Drag-Rides, special weapons, and custom experimental variants.
periods.origin: Excavated from ancient ruins discovered around the world during the previous decade-plus.
limitations: difficult to repair or understand fully
requires aptitude and paired Sword Device
Divine Drag-Rides impose severe stamina and mental burden
